$comment: 语法大厅 G41（V0.9 P3 进阶层，暗线主打课）。比喻锚点：和弦：两个音一起响才是那个意思。只讲初中高频短语动词（四天王 get/take/put/come + look/turn 家族）、可分与不可分、代词居中、look forward to 介词门。暗线主打：最常用的动词恰恰搭配最多最不讲理——越常用越多义。词源与频率只用通行结论。全部内容原创。
title: 短语动词与固定搭配
metaphor: 和弦：两个音一起响才是那个意思
ketNote: 老实说：KET 只考 get up / turn on 这类最高频的几个，不考系统辨析。短语动词是初中和 PET 词汇题的大头——这课为它打底，学到就是赚到，不用焦虑。

sections.essence: 动词+小品词=和弦：两个音一起响才是那个意思；代词要放中间。
sections.why: look 是「看」，after 是「在后」——可 look after 是「照顾」，跟「往后看」毫无关系。短语动词的意思不是零件相加，而像和弦：C 和 E 单独弹是两个音，一起响才是那个和弦。更有意思的是：英语里搭配最多的恰恰是 get、take、put、come 这几个最简单的动词——因为用得最多，被拉去表达的场景最杂，磨出的引申义最厚。所以学法只有一个：整块记，别拆开翻译。还有一条位置规矩：可分的短语动词带代词时，代词必须夹在中间——turn it on，不是 turn on it。
sections.metaphorStory: 和弦课第二讲。学徒抱着词典发愁：「look 是看，after 是后面——look after 怎么就成了照顾？」师傅按下琴键：「你听，C 和 E 单独弹是两个音，一起响是一个和弦。和弦不能拆成单音去理解，短语动词也一样——整块记。」墙上挂着一张搭配榜，四位老团员领衔：get 排第一（get up、get on、get off、get back、get on well with），take、put、come 各占一串。学徒问：「为什么越简单的词搭配越多？」师傅说：「用得多，磨得多——每个搭配都是千百年高频使用压出来的老茧。你看楼梯，凹得最深的永远是最中间那级。」最后一条规矩写在榜底：turn it on——代词这个小音符必须夹在中间，turn on it 是踩错了位置。

cards.rule: 短语动词 = 和弦，整块记
cards.detail: 动词 + 小品词的意思常常猜不出来——别逐字翻译，当一个新词记。
cards.example: look after 照顾 · give up 放弃 · take after 长得像

cards.rule: 高频四天王：get / take / put / come
cards.detail: get up 起床 · get on/off 上/下车 · take off 脱下/起飞 · take care of 照看 · put on 穿上 · put off 推迟 · put away 收好 · come true 实现 · come back 回来。

cards.rule: 可分型：代词必须夹中间
cards.detail: 名词可中可后（turn on the light / turn the light on）；代词只能居中。
cards.example: turn it on（✗ turn on it）· pick her up（✗ pick up her）

cards.detail: look after、listen to、wait for、look for 这类，宾语一律跟在整块后面。
cards.example: look after her / wait for him

cards.rule: look forward to 的 to 是介词门
cards.detail: 后面只收打包件 doing（G31 的门规）；be used to（G39）同款。
cards.example: I'm looking forward to seeing you.

cards.detail: 同一个动词配不同小品词，意思各不相同——一个个对号入座。
cards.example: turn on 开 · turn off 关 · turn up 调大 · turn down 调小

basic.en: I get up at six thirty.
She looks after her little brother.

mid.en: He took off his coat and put it on the chair.
mid.cn: 他脱下外套，放在椅子上。

mid.en: I'm looking for my keys — have you seen them?
mid.cn: 我在找钥匙——你见到了吗？

mid.en: The match was put off because of the rain.
mid.cn: 比赛因雨推迟了。（G29 的被动）

mid.en: Pick up your toys and put them away.
mid.cn: 把玩具捡起来收好。（them 夹中间）

mid.en: We're looking forward to visiting the music hall.
mid.cn: 我们盼着去参观音乐厅。（to + doing）

trap.note: 代词必须夹中间——turn on it 踩错位置。

trap.en: I'm looking forward to hearing from you.
trap.note: 这个 to 是介词门——只收打包件（G31）。

trap.en: The plane took off on time.
trap.note: take off 的另一个和弦——起飞；同一组键，两首曲子。
take after = 长得像——猜不出来的和弦，整块记。

trap.en: Please look up the word in the dictionary.
trap.note: look up = 查（词典）——和 look for（找东西）是两个和弦。

trap.en: He gets on well with his classmates.
trap.note: get on well with——get 家族搭配最多，最不讲理。

redBlack.bad: Please open the TV.（想说：打开电视）
redBlack.why: open 是「打开门/盖子」——听的人以为你要拆电视；电器的开关是 turn on / off。

redBlack.bad: I will look my little sister this weekend.（想说：照顾妹妹）
redBlack.good: I will look after my little sister this weekend.
redBlack.why: 和弦少了一个音——look 单弹是「看」，「照顾」这层意思整个消失。

redBlack.bad: Please turn on it — it's dark here.
redBlack.good: Please turn it on — it's dark here.
redBlack.why: 代词必须夹在中间——turn it on。

redBlack.bad: I'm looking forward to see you soon.
redBlack.good: I'm looking forward to seeing you soon.
redBlack.why: look forward to 的 to 是介词门——收打包件 seeing。

redBlack.bad: The concert was put away because of the storm.（想说：推迟）
redBlack.good: The concert was put off because of the storm.
redBlack.why: put off 推迟 / put away 收好——差一个小品词，两个和弦。

redBlack.bad: He picked up her at the airport.
redBlack.good: He picked her up at the airport.

redBlack.bad: I have to look for the new words in the dictionary.（想说：查词典）
redBlack.good: I have to look up the new words in the dictionary.
redBlack.why: 查词典是 look up；look for 是找丢了的东西。
固定搭配 come true——real 顶替不了 true。

redBlack.bad: We should take care for the school piano.
redBlack.good: We should take care of the school piano.
redBlack.why: 固定搭配 take care of——介词换不得。

redBlack.bad: She gave up eat snacks before bed.
redBlack.good: She gave up eating snacks before bed.
redBlack.why: give up 后接打包件 doing（G31 的门规）。

redBlack.bad: turn on the light / turn the light on（有人说只有一种对）
redBlack.why: 可分型的名词可中可后——只有代词必须居中，不设坑。

redBlack.bad: get on the bus / get in the car（有人觉得乱）
redBlack.good: 大车用 on，小车用 in——习惯而已。
redBlack.why: 公交/火车 get on，轿车 get in——习惯搭配，不挡意思。

contrast.diff: 中文一个动词；英语动词+小品词合奏，意思整块记。

contrast.cn: 开灯、开门、开会、开车（一个「开」通吃）
contrast.diff: 中文「开」是万能键；英语每个「开」各有各的和弦。

contrast.cn: 把它打开（「它」想放哪放哪）
contrast.en: turn it on（代词必须居中）
contrast.diff: 英语可分短语动词对代词位置有硬规定。

contrast.cn: 盼着见到你（看不出有「门」）
contrast.diff: to 是介词门——英语必须投打包件 doing。
逐字翻译不地道——固定搭配是磨出来的老茧，整块记。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 整块记不拆解；代词夹中间；to 门看清；换个小品词就是另一个和弦。
steps: 见到动词 + up / off / on / after 这类小尾巴——先当一个整体查意思，别逐字翻。
代词宾语一律夹中间：turn it on、pick her up、put them away。
名词宾语两个位置都行：turn on the light / turn the light on。
不可分的整块不拆：look after her、wait for him、listen to it。
look forward to、be used to 的 to 是介词门——接 doing。
换小品词 = 换和弦：put on 穿 / put off 推迟 / put away 收好——逐个对号。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，咱们做『和弦收藏卡』：每周收 5 个短语动词，正面写英语背面写中文。我抽卡你表演——抽到 turn on 你就做开灯的动作，抽到 put away 你就把桌上的东西收好，做错动作卡片归我。」再玩『代词居中』纠错：我故意说 turn on it、pick up her，你听到就喊『音符站错位』并说出正确的 turn it on、pick her up。我不懂英语没关系——这两组每次都是三个词，正确的那个，it 和 her 的音在中间。最后每周把收藏卡洗一遍抽考，攒到 30 张，短语动词的底子就厚了。
questions: look after 为什么不能拆成「看+后面」来理解？该怎么记？
turn it on 和 turn on it，哪个对？规矩是什么？
put on、put off、put away 各是什么意思？差在哪个音上？

sections.echo: ★ 这一课是暗线的主打：为什么 get、take、put、come 这些最简单的动词，恰恰搭配最多、最不讲理？答案是使用频率——一个词用得越多，被拉去表达的场景越杂，磨出的引申义越厚。get 能配几十个小品词，每个组合都是千百年高频使用压出来的老茧；而「光合作用」这种低频词，一辈子只有一个意思、零个搭配。「越常用越不规则」在词汇层的完整版本就是：越常用，越多义，搭配越多，越不讲理。这和 G13 的发现（最常用的 40 个动词恰恰全不规则）是同一条定律的两面——语言的磨损永远集中在最常被摸的地方，就像楼梯凹得最深的总是最中间那级。

questions.q: look after 的意思是？
questions.explain: 两个音一起响才是「照顾」——拆开就没了。

questions.q: 短语动词的意思应该怎么学？
questions.explain: 和弦不能拆成单音理解。

questions.q: give up 的意思是？
questions.explain: give up——放弃。

questions.q: get up 的意思是？
questions.explain: get up——起床。

questions.q: turn on 的意思是？
questions.explain: 电器开关的「开」。

questions.q: turn off 的意思是？
questions.explain: 电器开关的「关」。

questions.q: 「把声音调小」用哪个和弦？
questions.explain: turn down 调小；turn up 调大。

questions.q: look for 的意思是？
questions.explain: look for——找丢了的东西。

questions.q: look up 常用来表示？
questions.explain: look up——查词典；和 look for 是两个和弦。

questions.q: put on 的意思是？
questions.explain: put on——穿上。

questions.q: take off 的两个常用意思是？
questions.explain: 同一组键，两首曲子。

questions.q: put off 的意思是？
questions.explain: put off——推迟。

questions.q: come true 的意思是？
questions.explain: come true——（梦想）成真。

questions.q: 可分短语动词带代词时，代词放哪？
questions.explain: 代词这个小音符必须夹中间。

questions.q: look forward to 后面接？
questions.explain: 这个 to 是介词门——收 doing。

questions.q: 哪组动词是「搭配最多的四天王」？
questions.explain: 越常用的动词搭配越多——四天王领衔。

stages.name: 选一选 · 接准小品词

questions.q: Please ___ the TV — the match is starting.
questions.explain: 电器用 turn on——open 是开门开盖。

questions.q: It's cold outside. ___ your coat.
questions.explain: 穿上——put on。

questions.q: The plane ___ at nine and landed at eleven.
questions.explain: 起飞——took off。

questions.q: Who ___ your little sister when Mum is away?
questions.explain: 照顾——look after。

questions.q: I can't find my pen. Could you help me ___ it?
questions.explain: 找东西——look for。

questions.q: The sports meeting was ___ because of the rain.
questions.explain: 推迟——put off（被动 G29）。

questions.q: ___ the music, please. Grandpa is sleeping.
questions.explain: 调小声——turn down。

questions.q: If you don't know the word, ___ in the dictionary.
questions.explain: 查词典 look up；代词 it 夹中间。

questions.q: Keep practising, and your dream will ___.
questions.explain: 梦想成真——come true。

questions.q: Please ___ your toys and put them away.
questions.explain: 捡起来——pick up。

questions.q: He ___ well with his new classmates.
questions.explain: 相处融洽——get on well with。

questions.q: We're looking forward to ___ the new film.
questions.explain: 介词门——to seeing。

questions.q: ___ your shoes before you step on the mat.
questions.explain: 脱鞋——take off。

questions.q: The bus stopped and we ___.
questions.explain: 下车——got off。

questions.q: Don't ___ — you're almost there!
questions.explain: 别放弃——give up。

questions.q: She ___ her grandma — the same smile and the same laugh.
questions.explain: 长得像——take after。

questions.q: 哪一句音符站对了？（请把它打开）
questions.explain: 代词夹中间。

questions.q: 哪一句门规对了？（我盼着收到你的来信）
options: I'm looking forward to hearing from you.
I'm looking forward to hear from you.
I'm look forward to hearing from you.
questions.explain: to 是介词门收 hearing；look 要变 looking。

questions.q: 哪一句和弦对了？（打开电视看新闻）
options: Turn on the TV and watch the news.
Open the TV and watch the news.
Turn the TV and watch the news.
questions.explain: 电器的开是 turn on。

questions.q: 哪一句音符站对了？（他在机场接她）
options: He picked her up at the airport.
He picked up her at the airport.
He picked up she at the airport.
questions.explain: 代词 her 夹中间。

questions.q: 哪一句和弦对了？（运动会因雨推迟了）
options: The sports meeting was put off because of the rain.
The sports meeting was put away because of the rain.
The sports meeting was put on because of the rain.
questions.explain: 推迟 put off——away 是收好，on 是穿上。

questions.q: 哪一句和弦齐了？（请照顾好班里的绿植）
options: Please look after the plants in our classroom.
Please look the plants in our classroom.
Please look up the plants in our classroom.
questions.explain: 照顾要 look after——缺了 after 只剩「看」。

questions.q: 哪一句和弦对了？（查查这个词什么意思）
options: Look up the word in the dictionary.
Look for the word in the dictionary.
Look after the word in the dictionary.
questions.explain: 查词典 look up。

questions.q: 哪一句门规对了？（他放弃了睡前吃零食）
options: He gave up eating snacks before bed.
He gave up to eat snacks before bed.
He gave up eat snacks before bed.
questions.explain: give up + doing。

questions.q: 哪一句全对？（脱掉外套挂起来）
options: Take off your coat and hang it up.
Take away your coat and hang up it.
Take off your coat and hang up it.
questions.explain: take off 脱；hang it up 代词居中。

questions.q: 哪一句搭配对了？（梦想终于实现了）
questions.explain: 固定搭配 come true。

questions.q: 哪一句音符站对了？（把它关小一点）
options: Please turn it down a little.
Please turn down it a little.
Please it turn down a little.
questions.explain: 代词 it 夹中间。

questions.q: 哪一句搭配对了？（我们要好好照看学校的钢琴）
options: We should take good care of the school piano.
We should take good care for the school piano.
We should take good care to the school piano.
questions.explain: take care of——of 换不得。

questions.q: 哪一句和弦对了？（公交来了，快上车）
options: Here comes the bus — get on quickly!
Here comes the bus — get up quickly!
Here comes the bus — get off quickly!
questions.explain: 上车 get on；get off 是下车。

questions.q: 哪一句和弦对了？（他和爷爷长得很像）
questions.explain: 长得像 take after——look after 成了照顾爷爷。

questions.q: 哪一句音符站对了？（先把它们收好）
questions.explain: 代词 them 夹中间，且用宾格。

questions.q: 哪一句搭配对了？（请等等我）
questions.explain: wait for——不可分整块记。

questions.q: 两空：It's dark. Please ___ the lamp, and when you leave, remember to ___.
questions.explain: 开灯 turn on；走时把它关掉 turn it off（代词居中）。

questions.q: 大考：The plane ___ in ten minutes — please ___ your phone.
questions.explain: 起飞 take off；关手机 turn off。

questions.q: 两空：___ your coat and ___ your slippers — dinner is ready.
questions.explain: 脱外套 take off；换上拖鞋 put on。

questions.q: The trip was ___ till May, but I'm still looking forward ___ it.
questions.explain: 推迟 put off；look forward to。

questions.q: 两空：She ___ the dress ___ in the fitting room, but decided not to buy it.
questions.explain: 试穿 try on——名词可拆在中间。

questions.q: 找错：哪句的代词站错了位置？
options: Wake up her at six, please.
Wake her up at six, please.
Please wake me up at six.
questions.explain: 代词必须夹中间——wake her up。

questions.q: 两空：The volunteers ___ the old man every weekend and help him ___ his medicine on time.
questions.explain: 照顾 look after；吃药说 take medicine。

questions.q: Our team never ___, and finally the dream of winning the cup ___.
questions.explain: 不放弃 give up；梦想成真 come true。

questions.q: 两空：___ the radio a little — I can hardly hear it. Not that much! Now ___ a bit.
questions.explain: 先调大 turn up；过头了再把它调小 turn it down。

questions.q: 找错：哪句的介词门后面投错了东西？
options: We look forward to hear the good news.
We look forward to hearing the good news.
I'm used to getting up early.
questions.explain: 介词门后要打包件——to hearing。

questions.q: He ___ in a fishing village and still goes back every summer.
questions.explain: 长大 grow up。

questions.q: 两空：Get ___ the bus at Golden Street, then get ___ at the third stop.
questions.explain: 上车 get on；下车 get off。

questions.q: The teacher asked us to ___ the new words and write ___ in our notebooks.
questions.explain: 查词 look up；把它们记下来 write them down——代词居中。

questions.q: 找错：哪句把两个和弦弄混了？
options: Please put off your wet shoes at the door.
Please take off your wet shoes at the door.
The match was put off till Friday.
questions.explain: 脱鞋是 take off——put off 是推迟。

questions.q: 两空：My little cousin ___ her mother, and she is well ___ by her grandparents on weekdays.
questions.explain: 长得像妈妈 take after；被外公外婆照顾 is well looked after（G29）。

questions.q: 大考二：三空：___ the light, ___ your pyjamas, and ___ your clothes for tomorrow — good night!
options: Turn off / put on / put away
Turn on / take off / put off
Turn down / put off / take out
questions.explain: 关灯 turn off；穿睡衣 put on；收好明天的衣服 put away。

detective.sentence: Please turn on it before the show starts.
detective.fixed: Please turn it on before the show starts.
detective.clue: 代词必须夹在中间——turn it on。

detective.sentence: I'm looking forward to visit the music hall.
detective.fixed: I'm looking forward to visiting the music hall.
detective.clue: look forward to 的 to 是介词门——收打包件 visiting。

detective.sentence: Open the radio and listen to the weather report.
detective.fixed: Turn on the radio and listen to the weather report.
detective.clue: 电器的开关是 turn on——open 是开门开盖。

detective.sentence: The picnic was put away till next Saturday.
detective.fixed: The picnic was put off till next Saturday.
detective.clue: 推迟是 put off——put away 是收好，差一个小品词就是另一个和弦。

detective.sentence: Who will look your dog when you travel?
detective.fixed: Who will look after your dog when you travel?
detective.clue: 「照顾」的和弦缺了 after 这个音。

detective.sentence: She picked up him at the station yesterday.
detective.fixed: She picked him up at the station yesterday.

detective.sentence: He gave up play computer games on school nights.
detective.fixed: He gave up playing computer games on school nights.
detective.clue: give up 后接打包件 playing（G31 的门规）。
